test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: The sum of the ages of a son and father is 52 years; after four years the age of the father will be four times that of the son. What is the present age ( in years) of the son?
solution:
**Given:**

The sum of the ages of a son and father is 52 years; after four years the age of the father will be four times that of the son.

**Formula used:**

Let the present age of the son be S and the present age of the father be F.

S + F = 52 ....(1)

F + 4 = 4(S + 4)

**Calculation:**

S + F = 52

F + 4 = 4(S + 4)

⇒ F + 4 = 4S + 16

⇒ F = 4S + 12

Substitute F in the first equation:

S + 4S + 12 = 52

⇒ 5S + 12 = 52

⇒ 5S = 40

⇒ S = 8

**∴ The present age ( in years) of the son is 8.**
